    StartersDoughboy's welcome-home wingsCrispy baked wings tossed in honey barbecue sauce with a splash of hot sauceHow to make it1kg chicken wings1 tbsp garlic powder120ml barbecue sauce2 tbsp honey1 tsp hot saucesalt, to tasteLeave the wings uncovered in the fridge overnight.Toss with garlic powder and salt.Bake at 220°C until crisp.Warm the barbecue sauce with honey and hot sauce.Toss the wings through the sauce and serve with plenty of napkins.Front porch devilled eggsEggs with mustard, sweet relish and hot sauce, dusted with smoked paprikaHow to make it8 eggs4 tbsp mayonnaise2 tsp yellow mustard1 tbsp sweet relish1 tsp hot saucesmoked paprika, to dustBoil the eggs, then cool and peel.Halve the eggs and mash the yolks with mayonnaise, mustard, relish and hot sauce until smooth.Pipe back into the whites.Chill, then dust with smoked paprika.Caramelised onion dip with ridged chipsThe corner store down the streetHow to make itAs written, serves 4Onions cooked slow until deep brown, folded through sour cream and cream cheese with chives and a dash of Worcestershire, served with ridged salted chips.Slice 3 brown onions thinly and cook in 30g butter and a splash of oil over low heat for 35 minutes, stirring, until deep brown.Cool completely.Beat 250g sour cream with 125g soft cream cheese, a dash of Worcestershire sauce, salt and pepper.Fold in the onions and a handful of chopped chives.Chill for an hour and serve with ridged potato chips.Grilled hot links with onionsRicky's SAT is done.
